mapper.select: SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO WHERE CUSTOMER_ID = #{custormId}
SELECT FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_MARKET_ID=#{ finprodMarketId }
SELECT COUNT(FINPROD_MARKET_ID) FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId}

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID finprodId, A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, A.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, A.FINPROD_TYPE2, A.CCY ccy, A.VDATE vdate, A.MDATE mdate, A.ISSUER issuer, A.CALENDAR_ID calendarId, A.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE capiIncomeFeature, A.TRUSTEE_ID trusteeId, A.MANAGER manager, A.ISSUE_AMT issueAmt, A.REMARK remark, B.TYPE_6 category, B.TYPE_7 type,
B.TYPE_9 type9, B.TYPE_10 type10, B.TYPE_11 type11, B.TYPE_12 type12, C.IS_OPEN_EVERYDAY isOpenEveryDay,
FPR.RECOMMENDER recommender,
C.IS_COMPOUND_INT isCompoundInt, D.ASSET_PROVIDER assetProvider, D.BANK_TRUST_CODE bankTrustCode, D.INVESTMENT_ATTRIBUTES investmentAttributes, D.ACTUAL_CREDIT_PROVID actualCreditProvid, T.PFLSH pflsh, T.HAP_CREDIT_AMT hapCreditAmt, T.CREDIT_FLAG creditFlag,
A.CONTRACT_NO contractNo, C.PUR_SPEED purSpeed, C.RED_SPEED redSpeed, C.CREDIT_ENHANCE_MEASURE creditEnhanceMeasure, C.FUND_MANGER_NAME fundMangerName, D.TRIAL_NO trialNo
FROM FIN_PRODUCT A
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_RECOMMENT FPR ON FPR.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT T2.FINPROD_ID,T1.PFLSH,T1.HAP_CREDIT_AMT ,T1.CUSTOMER_ID ,T1.CREDIT_FLAG FROM CREDIT_LINES T1 LEFT JOIN CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL T2 ON T2.SEQNO = T1.CUSTOMER_ID) T ON (T.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID OR T.CUSTOMER_ID = A.FINPROD_ID), FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE B, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD C, PA_FIN_PRODUCT D WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
